corrected_prompt:
STYLE: Stop-motion clay puppet scene - clay characters detailed with tiny craft materials: thread-wrapped hair, fabric details, wire accents, on a fully sculpted clay set, cinematic stop-motion film lighting with gentle shadows, the scene filling the entire frame with the camera inside the puppet world. Palette: warm cream, terracotta and mustard clay with deep teal shadows, warm amber light; one bright subject against a calm, plain clay wall.

FORMAT AND LAYOUT: one vertical 9:16 image (portrait, 9 wide by 16 tall). Positions are fractions of the frame from the top-left corner. The top 30% of the frame is only plain clay wall, empty, kept clear for words added later. The main subject sits between 30% and 84% down. Nothing important in the bottom 16% or the right 13% of the frame.

SUBJECT, THE BLINDFOLDED POST: one talking clay post card stands upright at the centre on two small clay feet on the set floor, from 22% to 74% across and from 38% to 84% down. It is a square card sculpted from cream clay with a stitched fabric edge and a simple clay face in its middle (a sculpted nose and a small wobbly-line mouth). A strip of red fabric is tied over its eyes as a blindfold, wrapped around the card's top third and knotted at its right edge. Two tiny wire arms are held out in front, feeling the air. Its head tilts a little: puzzled and a little sheepish.
BEHIND IT: one calendar month page hangs flat on the wall, softly out of focus, from 20% to 80% across and from 32% to 66% down, sculpted from flat cream clay with a stitched fabric border and a stitched grid of empty day squares; every square is empty.

SETTING: one plain warm cream clay wall fills the background, a plain clay floor meets the wall at 84% down; warm amber light from the upper left, gentle deep teal shadows low down. No window, shelf, desk or other objects. Camera at the post's eye level. Medium shot of the post with the calendar behind it.

Must also not include: no human figures or people (the clay post card character is wanted); nothing on the calendar page; one post only.

HANDS: no human hands, fingers or arms anywhere in the picture.

TEXT: none. No text, letters, numbers or words anywhere in the picture: not on the calendar, the wall or any object. The calendar's day squares are empty stitched squares with no numbers, and there is no month name.

CAMERA: macro miniature-set look, about 50mm, shallow depth of field, the main subject sharp; the camera sits inside the miniature clay world.

DO NOT INCLUDE: no text, letters, numbers or words; no hearts, likes, thumbs-up, follower counts, notification badges, social media icons or logos; no real platform names, logos or app screens; no phone screens; no extra subjects beyond those named; no clutter in the top third; no smooth, glossy or CGI-looking surfaces; no motion blur; no border or frame around the whole picture, no split screens, no set edges, workbench or the room around the miniature set (the calendar page keeps its stitched fabric border).

Everything in frame is real modeling clay, photographed - visible fingerprints and tool marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting, the clay scene filling the entire frame.
